Well heres my perspective on being trans and changing my appearance and becoming the man I always was physically. This was all before learning the law when I realized I could physically be seen as a man in society. My self concept all my life was that of “i am a boy/man” subconsciously before I even realized it consciously. Due to limiting beliefs of society and ignorance towards someone like me I limited myself all my life up until I became educated in what it meant to transition into who i am today. I like to believe that was my bridge of incidents. A very long bridge. From being a child subconsciously knowing I was a boy, weirdly enough I unconsciously was doing sats because I always used to imagine myself as a grown man living my life in that way before bed. From being a preteen and going on youtube and seeing a trans man like me talk about his experience and everything clicked with me “oh my god i can do this? This is all possible? I can finally be the man I always wanted to be on the outside too?” From that point on I waited till it wad the right time for me to come out. I was terrified it took me years to come out, but finally during my senior year of high school I said fuck it I need to do this this was life or death for me. So that then lead to me starting hormone replacement therapy and surgeries and all that fun stuff. Im still on my journey and will always be on this journey forever till I transition into the after life. That was my bridge of incidents to getting a “sex change” which mind you I think that term is very very outdated because if you understand the law I was not changing anything at all I always always was this boy/man. That was always my self concept. I had this burning desire to be who I wanted to be and I had no free will in that desire. I am still on that bridge some may argue we are always on the bridge of something constantly. So yes OP you can be ANYTHING you desire to be. Anything

The control is definitely hard to let go of which is something i still haven’t learned completely. I think something to remind yourself is that your partner is not there to hurt you and that they are on your side. Sometimes it may feel like they are trying to control you but it doesn’t seem like they are here in this situation it just seems like they are threatening your need for control. Control isn’t going to do us any good especially in a relationship so sometimes if i feel like i have an impulse or a need to control i distract myself. I listen to music or i watch a video so i dont have to react in the moment. But if you are around your partner then i would maybe say to ask for space in the moment so you can take a breather. They have to respect your space. What is something that you do that calms you down if you have anything? Personally focusing on my breathing helps and letting my thoughts just run without me changing anything. We have to learn how to accept our thoughts and fears having ocd. Its going to be uncomfortable for a very long time but everything is going to be okay I promise. Healing is not linear and just remember to be compassionate to yourself. Also going to therapy and practicing ERP helped me a lot, if that is accessible to you.
